## 1. Load packages

```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tmap)
library(readxl)
```

## 2. Import spatial and statistical data

```{r}
london <- st_read(
  "../statistical-gis-boundaries-london/ESRI/London_Borough_Excluding_MHW.shp"
)

fly_tipping <- read_excel(
  "../fly-tipping-borough.xlsx"
)
```

## 3. Clean the fly-tipping data

Convert the missing value symbol ":" to NA.

```{r}
fly_tipping_clean <- fly_tipping %>%
  mutate(
    total_action_taken = as.numeric(
      na_if(total_action_taken, ":")
    )
  )
```

## 4. Reshape the data

Create one row per borough and one column per year.

```{r}
fly_tipping_wide <- fly_tipping_clean %>%
  select(code, year, total_action_taken) %>%
  group_by(code, year) %>%
  summarise(
    total_action_taken = if (all(is.na(total_action_taken))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      sum(total_action_taken, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = total_action_taken
  )

dim(fly_tipping_wide)
```

## 5. Join statistical data to spatial data

Join the two datasets using borough codes.

```{r}
london_joined <- london %>%
  left_join(
    fly_tipping_wide,
    by = c("GSS_CODE" = "code")
  )

dim(london_joined)

sum(is.na(london_joined[["2011-12"]]))
```

## 6. Create a choropleth map

The map shows the number of fly-tipping actions taken in London boroughs in 2011-12.

```{r}
tmap_mode("plot")

final_map <- tm_shape(london_joined) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "2011-12",
    fill.legend = tm_legend(
      title = "Actions taken"
    )
  ) +
  tm_title("Fly-tipping Actions in London (2011-12)")

final_map
```

## 7. Export the spatial dataset

```{r eval=FALSE}
st_write(
  london_joined,
  "London_Fly_Tipping.gpkg"
)
```

## 8. Interpretation

The choropleth map illustrates differences in the number of fly-tipping actions taken across London boroughs.

Higher numbers of actions do not necessarily indicate higher levels of fly-tipping, as enforcement and reporting practices may differ between boroughs.
